title: The Opinions You Carry
quote: my opinions alone are mine and they cannot be taken from me

title: What Friendship Rests On
quote: For where else is friendship than where there is fidelity, and modesty, where there is a communion of honest things and of nothing else.

quote: The man did not know the rest of my faults, for he would not have mentioned these only.

quote: Let death and exile and every other thing which appears dreadful be daily before your eyes; but most of all death: and you will never think of anything mean nor will you desire anything extravagantly.

quote: remember that now is the contest, now are the Olympic games, and they cannot be deferred

quote: Let it be our most earnest study, therefore, to dwell upon the life of Jesus Christ.

quote: All of us are weak and frail; hold thou no man more frail than thyself.

title: Knowing Yourself
quote: A lowly knowledge of thyself is a surer way to God than the deep searching of man’s learning.

quote: Do what lieth in thy power, and God will help thy good intent.

quote: Look well unto thyself, and beware that thou judge not the doings of others.

quote: Endeavour to be patient in bearing with other men’s faults and infirmities whatsoever they be, for thou thyself also hast many things which have need to be borne with by others.

title: Losing and Finding Yourself
quote: For verily, by loving myself amiss, I lost myself, and by seeking and sincerely loving Thee alone, I found both myself and Thee

quote: Blessed are the single-hearted, for they shall have abundance of peace.

title: Words That Build Up
quote: If it be right and desirable for thee to speak, speak things which are to edification.

quote: In silence and quiet the devout soul goeth forward and learneth the hidden things of the Scriptures.

title: Rich in Christ
quote: When thou hast Christ, thou art rich, and hast sufficient.

title: Peace Begins at Home
quote: First keep thyself in peace, and then shalt thou be able to be a peacemaker towards others.

title: What Temptation Reveals
quote: Oftentimes we know not what strength we have; but temptation revealeth to us what we are.

title: The Way of Peace
quote: Strive, My Son, to do another’s will rather than thine own.

quote: Blessed is the soul which heareth the Lord speaking within it, and receiveth the word of consolation from His mouth.

title: Strength for the Journey

quote: Come unto Me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will refresh you

title: Give Me Yourself
quote: Give me Thyself and it sufficeth, for besides Thee no consolation availeth.

title: Thankful for Small Things
